title: JetBlue Joins Race for Premium Travelers With Domestic First Class Seats
summary: JetBlue is joining the industry’s race for premium-paying travelers, rolling out first class seating on domestic flights this fall. title: JetBlue Announces Board Changes
summary: NEW YORK, August 27, 2026--JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today announced that two members of its board of directors, Jesse Lynn and Steven Miller, will be departing the board.
